purpose: Field registry for the Data Quality Control Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name from the frozen input JSON.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity for the candidate freeze.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm or workflow-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise family phrase from the Layer 1 row and verified method evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates spatially aware QC from broader preprocessing/QC pipeline methods.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input object or data stage for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing rather than parameter lists.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes post-count spatial QC from upstream read/preprocessing workflows.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Data Quality Control.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the QC or preprocessing-QC role; avoid unrelated downstream claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps preprocessing-adjacent methods scoped to this analysis problem.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to the topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use short object-level phrasing such as QC calls, filtered object, metrics, or processed spatial expression object.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes QC annotations from broad preprocessing products.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use local alternatives only; for this two-method topic, use the other frozen candidate when relevant.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports local comparison without global ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds branch-local method selection.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement only.
fields.fill_rule: Use the coarse label supported by registry and method evidence; do not infer runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a branch-local resource cue, not an execution claim.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents overconfident memory claims for recently published QC tools.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger spatial scale, multiple samples, or high-throughput sequencing inputs.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless public evidence directly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps atlas-scale or multi-sample caution visible without inventing benchmark results.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when an official or clearly primary code/documentation source is confirmed.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable source for later engineering review.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes direct method-paper evidence from documentation and Layer 2 synthesis.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on what is direct evidence and what is Layer 2 synthesized judgment.
fields.fill_rule: Use one to two concise sentences. Explicitly mark comparisons, resource cautions, and selection roles as synthesized when appropriate.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps evidence strength and uncertainty visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse without claiming runtime failure.

fields.name: QC Target Level
fields.definition: Primary level at which the method acts for data quality control.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value. Use mixed only when the method directly spans more than one level.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates local spatial QC from pipeline-level quality control.

fields.name: Input Processing Stage
fields.definition: Where the method enters the spatial transcriptomics data-production path.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value for the dominant expected stage.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents selecting a post-count QC method for raw-read preprocessing or vice versa.

fields.name: Platform Scope
fields.definition: Coarse spatial transcriptomics platform scope indicated by method evidence.
fields.fill_rule: Use a broad platform cue and avoid unsupported exhaustive compatibility claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps branch between spot-object QC and sequencing-based preprocessing.

fields.name: Spatial Artifact Handling
fields.definition: Whether spatially structured artifacts are an explicit selection target.
fields.fill_rule: Use explicit when spatial artifact handling is a method-paper focus; use general QC metrics for broader QC workflows.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures the central selection difference in this topic.

fields.name: Pipeline Breadth
fields.definition: Whether the method is a focused QC method or broader preprocessing/QC pipeline.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value based on the method's primary reusable contribution.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local choice between focused artifact QC and general preprocessing workflow.
